verses.text: 59. In order to gather together scattered humanity God calls Abram from his country, his kindred, and his father’s house, (Gen 12:1.) and makes him Abraham, that is, “the father of a multitude of nations.” “In you all the nations of the earth shall be blessed.” (Gen 17:5; 12:3 (LXX); cf. Gal 3:8.)
